title: DeadLetterEvent
description: Envelope wrapping any event that could not be processed by a consumer. Published to the <original-topic>.dlq Kafka topic. Enables reprocessing, alerting, and compliance audit of failed messages.

dlqEventId.description: Unique identifier for this dead-letter record.

originalTopic.description: Kafka topic the message was originally consumed from.

originalPartition.description: Kafka partition the message was consumed from.

originalOffset.description: Kafka offset of the original message.

originalEventId.description: metadata.eventId of the original event, if the message was parseable.

originalEventType.description: metadata.eventType of the original event, if the message was parseable.

originalEventVersion.description: metadata.eventVersion of the original event, if the message was parseable.

consumerGroup.description: Kafka consumer group that failed to process the message.

consumerService.description: Microservice name that failed to process the message.

failureType.description: SCHEMA_VALIDATION = message failed JSON Schema validation. DESERIALIZATION = Avro/JSON parse error. BUSINESS_RULE = schema was valid but business logic rejected it. DOWNSTREAM_TIMEOUT = a downstream call timed out. UNKNOWN = unclassified.

failureReason.description: Human-readable description of why processing failed. Include exception class and message.

validationErrors.description: Structured validation errors, populated when failureType is SCHEMA_VALIDATION.

instancePath.description: JSON Pointer to the failing field, e.g. /payload/rail.

schemaPath.description: JSON Pointer into the schema where the rule is defined.

attemptCount.description: Number of delivery attempts made before routing to DLQ, including this final attempt.

originalPayload.description: Raw original message body as a base64-encoded string. Always captured regardless of whether parsing succeeded, enabling replay.

traceId.description: Distributed trace ID from the original event, if extractable.
